name: PCC Database VEGETATION COVER - network of research plots on cocoa agroforestry and forest in Waslala Nicaragua
description: Database with information FOR 40 cocoa agroforestry plots, regarding soil cover in terms of vegetation, litter and other materials. Vegetation cover is divided between shade cover and auto-shade cover of the cacao canopy. Esta base contiene los datos de cobertura del suelo por vegetación, hojarasca u otros materiales, también la cobertura de sombra y autosombra de la vegetación del dosel de sombra de los cacaotales.
producers: Cacao Centroamerica Project part of the Mesoamerican Agroenvironmental Programme
